question: A train starts from a place Mumbai at 6 a.m. and arrives at Kolhapur at 2.30 p.m. on the same day. If the speed of the train is 60 km per hour, find the distance traveled by the train.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total time of journey = 6:00 a.m. to 2:30 p.m. = 8.5 hours.

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 60 × 8.5 = 510 km.

**∴ The correct answer is 510 km.**
